empty.title: Nothing here yet
empty.description: There is nothing to show right now.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.description: We could not load this. Try again. If it keeps happening, tell your supervisor.

offline.title: You are offline
offline.description: Connect to the internet and try again. Your saved work stays on this phone.

denied.title: You cannot open this
denied.description: Your role does not include this. Ask your supervisor if you think this is wrong.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.invalid: The email, phone number or password is not right. Check and try again.
auth.rateLimited: Too many tries. Wait one minute and try again.
auth.unavailable: Sign-in is not working right now. Try again in a few minutes.
auth.offline: You are offline. Connect to the internet to sign in.
auth.expired: This phone was offline for more than 7 days, so saved data was removed. Sign in again.
auth.loggedOut: You have signed out. Data on this phone was removed.
auth.sessionEnded: Your session ended. Sign in again to keep sending your work.
auth.unlock: Sign in again to open the work saved on this phone.

signOut.title: Sign out?
signOut.description: Everything saved on this phone will be removed.
signOut.pendingWarning_one: {{count}} item has not been sent yet and will be lost.
signOut.pendingWarning_other: {{count}} items have not been sent yet and will be lost.

wrongApp.title: Use the officer website
wrongApp.description: Your role works in the officer website, not in the field app.

offlineGuard.offline: Offline: your work is saved on this phone and will be sent when you are back online.
offlineGuard.warn_one: Connect to the internet within {{count}} day, or the data saved on this phone will be removed.
offlineGuard.warn_other: Connect to the internet within {{count}} days, or the data saved on this phone will be removed.

home.title: What needs you now
home.offlineNote: You are offline. Showing what was saved at {{time}}.
home.unsent_one: {{count}} item is waiting to be sent. Open the sync queue.
home.unsent_other: {{count}} items are waiting to be sent. Open the sync queue.

nothing.title: Nothing needs you right now
nothing.description: New work will show up here.

queue.title: Sync queue
queue.description: Work saved on this phone and whether it has been sent.
queue.waitingFor: Waiting for an earlier item to be sent.

attention.access_changed: Needs attention: your access changed. This item can no longer be sent. Ask your supervisor.
attention.conflict: Someone changed this before you. Review the differences.
attention.rejected: This was not accepted ({{code}}). Check it or ask your supervisor.
attention.retries_exhausted: Could not send after several tries. Try again when the network is better.

capture.title: Take a photo
capture.noPatients: Do not include patients or their details in the photo.

problem.type: This file type cannot be used. Take a JPEG or PNG photo.
problem.size: The photo is too large (more than 10 MB). Take it again at a lower quality.
problem.read: The photo could not be read. Take it again.

diff.title: Review differences
diff.caption: Your change compared with the latest version
diff.explain_one: Someone saved a newer version first. {{count}} field is different. Choose what to keep.
diff.explain_other: Someone saved a newer version first. {{count}} fields are different. Choose what to keep.
diff.reapplied: Your change will be sent again.
diff.discarded: Your change was removed. The latest version is kept.

gone.title: Nothing to review
gone.description: This item has no differences to review any more.

comingSoon.title: This screen is not ready yet
comingSoon.description: It will be added soon. Use Home for your current work.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: This page does not exist. Go back to Home.

list.title: Ward assessments
list.description: Download a ward while online, then complete it offline. It is sent when the network returns.

empty.title: No wards to assess
empty.description: There is no open cycle or no ward in your area. Ask your district quality manager.

list.downloadFailed: The ward could not be downloaded. Try again when online.

local.read_only: Read-only: start again on the new version

list.offlineOnlyDownloads: You are offline. Only the wards on this phone are shown.

form.title: Ward assessment

notDownloaded.title: This assessment is not on this phone
notDownloaded.description: Open the ward list while online and download the ward.

form.noPatientText: Do not write patient names or details.
form.declaration: I confirm that no patient can be identified in this assessment, its notes or its photos.
form.queuedOffline: Assessment saved. It will be sent when you are online.
form.queuedInfo: This assessment is queued. Photos are sent first, then the assessment.
form.grace: A newer checklist was published. This version can still be sent until {{date}}.
form.retired: This checklist version was replaced more than 7 days ago. Your draft is kept read-only. Start again on the new version.

problem.version_retired: This checklist version can no longer be sent.
